stories.title: Source: LB Miller expected to sign with Cowboys
stories.summary: Eight-time Pro Bowl linebacker Von Miller is expected to sign with the Dallas Cowboys, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Sources: Cardinals RB Love has high ankle sprain
stories.summary: Rookie running back Jeremiyah Love, who played 23 snaps on Thursday against the Las Vegas Raiders, is dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unlikely to play the rest of the preseason for the Arizona Cardinals, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter Sunday.

stories.title: Vikings lose Adams for season due to knee injury
stories.summary: Veteran defender Jamal Adams will miss the 2026 season because of a right knee injury he suffered Saturday in the Minnesota Vikings' 13-10 preseason victory over the New York Giants, the NFL Network reported Sunday.

stories.title: Scheffler opens playoffs with dominant 8-shot win
stories.summary: Scottie Scheffler was back to his dominant form Sunday, winning the FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots to open the PGA Tour postseason.

stories.title: Mitchell, Spieth find water, out of Tour playoffs
stories.summary: Keith Mitchell and Jordan Spieth hit shots into the water on the final few holes Sunday, preventing them from advancing in the FedEx Cup postseason.
